content_data.project_title: Interactive Narrative Experience for Global Teen Audiences
content_data.project_description: A proposal for developing a transmedia storytelling project designed to engage a global teen demographic through interactive narratives across multiple digital platforms.
content_data.timeline: Over a 10-month period, including concept development (months 1-2), content creation (months 3-7), and launch/promotion (months 8-10)
objectives: Generate measurable user-generated content and community participation
Expand brand reach into key international markets previously underserved
Establish a new benchmark for interactive storytelling within the entertainment industry
deliverables: Launch campaign content package (copy, visuals, ad concepts)
